name: IWCITY
recent: IWCITY 近期持续就重大诉讼发布公告，并因触及 Rule 8.03A 而按月提交更新。公司于 8 月底公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩，9 月更换注册地址。
notable: 公司就重大诉讼发布公告（2026 年 10 月及 11 月）。
公司公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩。
risks: 公司涉及重大诉讼，并持续发布相关公告。
公司属于 Rule 8.03A 公司，须按月提交公告。

ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: IWCITY has issued repeated announcements on material litigation and files monthly updates as a Rule 8.03A company. It released results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 in late August and changed its registered address in September.
notable_en: The company issued material litigation announcements in October and November 2026.
The company announced results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
The company changed its registered address.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation and continues to issue related announcements.
The company is a Rule 8.03A company and must submit monthly announcements.
